question: In February 2026, which female cheetah gave birth to 3 cubs at Kuno National Park, marking the 9th successful litter on Indian soil?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gamini.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

 
• In February 2026, the South African cheetah **Gamini** gave birth to three cubs at Kuno National Park in Madhya Pradesh.
 
• This was reported as the **9th successful cheetah litter** on Indian soil since the start of the reintroduction project.
